define_type_alias_shape: define a Shape type alias as a tuple of integers for array dimensions
define_type_alias_key: define a Key type alias as a JAX PRNG key array for random number generation
create_typed_decorator: create a typed decorator that applies jaxtyping and typeguard runtime type checking to functions
apply_typed_to_function: apply the typed decorator to a function for runtime type validation of arguments and return values
use_typed_for_array_operations: use the typed decorator on array operations to enforce Shape and Key type annotations
